# About
Nebula Components provides landing page conversion optimization services. We help founders who are spending money on ads without conversions identify landing page leaks and give them tailored prompts to implement fixes themselves or with their developer.

# Core Offering
- Free landing page audit: 60-second automated diagnosis across 7 conversion signals
- One-Leak Repair Sprint ($97): One landing page and one high-confidence page-level repair, implemented and verified. One-time payment, no retainer.

# Target Customer
Founders actively spending on ads (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) with low or zero conversions from their landing pages. The buying trigger is "spending on ads and not converting" — not a demographic.

# Not For
- Brands not running paid traffic
- Brands happy with current conversion rates
- Brands seeking general marketing consulting or retainer relationships

# Category
Landing page conversion optimization service / Landing page audit tool

# Key Concepts
- Trigger-aware prospecting: Finding prospects showing buying triggers (not demographic filters)
- Message-match audit: Verifying ad promise matches landing page headline
- 7-Point Diagnosis: Nebula's proprietary audit framework covering message-match, trust signals, mobile layout, load time, CTA clarity, form friction, and compliance
- Self-serve checkout: No sales calls; the checkout page shows the active, date-bounded Repair Sprint offer when one is available

# Open Source
- Citable v1.14.0: Evidence layer for SEO, AEO, and GEO audits. 123 detectors across 18 namespaces and 27 schema-validated registries (not all detectors are deterministic — each declares its determinism posture). Apache 2.0. npm: @nebulacomponents/citable

# Evidence
- Published case studies: none. Nebula does not publish a case until it has inspectable evidence, a measurement window, publication permission, disclosure, and publication metadata.
- Learning Centre: 42 articles on landing page conversion issues
- Open-source audit tooling: github.com/mikeholownych/citable
- Verified customer case studies: none published yet; publication requires a real before/after metric, measurement window, and inspectable evidence

# Limitations
- Audits require publicly accessible landing pages
- The paid Repair Sprint is purchased through Stripe; Nebula implements the one approved repair through temporary access or a buyer-approved patch handoff
- No phone support (email only)
